title: eludite.editor.rename input
description: Rename the symbol at `line`, `column` (or the caret) across the solution (Ctrl+R, Ctrl+R or F2). The language server checks the position first (textDocument/prepareRename); a position that cannot be renamed is `rejected` ("You must rename an identifier."). Without `new_name` this opens the Rename dialog: a box with the symbol's name, a preview tree of the files and changed lines (textDocument/rename, refreshed as the name changes), Apply and Cancel (Escape). With `new_name` it computes the rename and, unless `apply` is false, applies it with the workspace-edit applier: open documents change in their buffers as one undo step each, closed files on disk. A new call cancels the previous request; a result for an older document version or solution generation is dropped.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.

line.description: 1-based line of the symbol; the caret when omitted.

column.description: 1-based column (characters) of the symbol; 1 when omitted.

new_name.description: The new name. Omit to open the dialog.

apply.description: With `new_name`: apply the rename (default true), or only compute the preview (false).
